title: FLAME: Condensing Ensemble Diversity into a Single Network for Efficient Sequential Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2604.04038v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Sequential recommendation requires capturing diverse user behaviors, which a single network often fails to capture. While ensemble methods mitigate this by leveraging multiple networks, training them all from scratch leads to high computational cost and instability from noisy mutual supervision. We propose Frozen and Learnable networks with Aligned Modular Ensemble (FLAME), a novel framework that condenses ensemble-level diversity into a single network for efficient sequential recommendation. During training, FLAME simulates exponential diversity using only two networks via modular ensemble. By decomposing each network into sub-modules (e.g., layers or blocks) and dynamically combining them, FLAME generates a rich space of diverse representation patterns. To stabilize this process, we pretrain and freeze one network to serve as a semantic anchor and employ guided mutual learning. This aligns the diverse representations into the space

translated_title: FLAME：将集成多样性压缩到单一网络中以实现高效序列推荐
translated_abstract: 序列推荐需要捕捉多样化的用户行为，而单一网络往往难以做到这一点。虽然集成方法通过利用多个网络来缓解这一问题，但从头训练所有网络会导致高计算成本以及来自嘈杂的相互监督的不稳定性。我们提出了冻结与可学习网络结合对齐模块化集成（FLAME），这是一种新颖的框架，将集成级别的多样性压缩到单一网络中以实现高效序列推荐。在训练过程中，FLAME通过模块化集成仅使用两个网络模拟指数级多样性。通过将每个网络分解为子模块（例如层或块）并动态组合它们，FLAME生成丰富的多样化表示模式空间。为了稳定这一过程，我们预训练并冻结一个网络作为语义锚点，并采用引导式相互学习。这将对齐的多样化表示融入该空间中。
tldr: 本文提出FLAME框架，通过模块化集成和冻结锚点网络，仅用两个网络模拟指数级多样性，并将集成多样性压缩到单一网络中，实现高效稳定的序列推荐。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FLAME, a framework that simulates exponential diversity with only two networks via modular ensemble and a frozen anchor, condensing ensemble diversity into a single network for efficient and stable sequential recommendation.
